# Daily Briefing – Friday 27 November

Yesterday was a tough one on the recovery side. No training session logged and just 7,292 steps, which is fine for a rest day, but that 2.3 hours of sleep is the real concern here — that's not enough for anyone, let alone someone training for a half marathon. Calories burned came in at 2,105kcal, so you're in a reasonable deficit without overdoing it.

That HRV of 57ms is well below your 88-117ms baseline, and sleep is almost certainly the culprit. Your body is waving a yellow flag today — not a red one, but listen to it. Keep any planned session easy: a gentle 20-30 minute walk or light movement only. No intensity today.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else. Aim for 8 hours — it'll do more for your 80kg goal and race prep than any workout right now. You've got 195 days; protect them.
